review_candidates.title: IT Support Specialist

Administer Microsoft 365, Windows Server and Active Directory. Maintain and troubleshoot wired networks, Wi-Fi, internet connections and VPN access, and monitor system performance. Maintain backups and support data recovery. Track company IT equipment and maintain records of system configurations and technical procedures. Requirements Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Scienc
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Requirements Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field. 2 to 4 years of experience in IT support, systems administration or IT infrastructure. Strong knowledge of Windows and Microsoft 365, hands-on networking experience, and knowledge of Active Directory and user management.
